children: Airtel Money is expected to file paperwork for its initial public offering to the London Stock Exchange as soon as Wednesday, aiming for a valuation of $8 billion to $9 billion, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday, citing two people briefed on the plans.
The company is looking to raise at least $800 million from investors, the report said.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
